description_en: Submits a job to a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用SubmitJob在指定集群提交作业
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc submit-job --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --command-line ./LammpsTest/lammps.pbs --runas-user testuser --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitJob

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The command to run the job
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业命令
parameters.name: command_line

parameters.help_en:
The username that is used to run the job.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html to query the usernames in the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
执行作业的用户名。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html获取该集群中的用户名
parameters.name: runas_user

parameters.help_en: The user password
parameters.help_zh: 用户密码
parameters.name: runas_user_password

parameters.help_en: The job name. The name must be 6 to 30 characters in length, start with a letter, and can contain digits and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh: 作业名称。长度为6~30个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含数字、半角句号（.）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The job priority. Valid values: 0 to 9. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
作业优先级，取值范围：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高。

默认值：0
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The path to run the job
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业路径
parameters.name: package_path

parameters.help_en: The path for standard output
parameters.help_zh: 标准输出路径
parameters.name: stdout_redirect_path

parameters.help_en: The path for error output
parameters.help_zh: 错误输出路径
parameters.name: stderr_redirect_path

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the job can be rerun. Valid values:
true: The job can be rerun.
false: The job cannot be rerun
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持重新执行作业。取值范围：
true：支持
false：不支持
parameters.name: re_runable

parameters.help_en:
The array job. 

Format: X-Y:Z. The minimum value X is the first index, the maximum value Y is the last index, and Z is the step size. For example, 2-7:2 indicates that the job queue contains three sub-jobs numbered 2, 4, and 6
parameters.help_zh:
队列作业。 

格式X-Y:Z， 最小值X是第一个索引，最大值Y是最后一个索引，Z表示步长，例如2-7:2，表示作业队列包含编号为2、4、6的3个子作业
parameters.name: array_request

parameters.help_en: The environment variables for the job. You can access the environment variables in the job execution file
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业的环境变量，可以在作业执行文件中访问环境变量
parameters.name: variables

parameters.help_en: The URL of the job file uploaded to Object Storage Service (OSS)
parameters.help_zh: 上传到OSS的作业文件的URL地址
parameters.name: input_file_url

parameters.help_en:
The command used to decompress the file downloaded from OSS. Valid values:

tar xzf: decompresses a gzip archive.

tar xf: decompresses a tar archive.

unzip: decompresses a zip archive
parameters.help_zh:
解压命令。解压OSS下载的文件。取值范围：

tar xzf：解开gzip格式压缩包

tar xf：解开tar格式压缩包

unzip：解开zip格式压缩包
parameters.name: unzip_cmd

parameters.help_en: The command to run after the job is submitted
parameters.help_zh: 提交作业后执行的命令
parameters.name: post_cmd_line

parameters.help_en:
The name of the queue in which the job runs.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92176.html to query the queue name
parameters.help_zh:
执行作业的队列名称。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92176.html获取队列名称
parameters.name: job_queue

parameters.help_en:
The number of compute nodes required to run the job.

If this parameter is left empty, the Cpu, Task, Thread, Mem, and Gpu parameters do not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
执行作业所需的计算节点数。

若该参数为空，则参数Cpu、Task、Thread、Mem、Gpu不生效
parameters.name: node

parameters.help_en: The number of CPU cores required for each compute node
parameters.help_zh: 单个计算节点所需的CPU核数
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en:
The number of processes created on each compute node.

This parameter is applicable to Message Passing Interface (MPI) jobs
parameters.help_zh:
单个计算节点创建的进程数。

适用于MPI作业
parameters.name: task

parameters.help_en:
The number of threads created on each compute node.

This parameter is applicable to OpenMP jobs
parameters.help_zh:
单个计算节点创建的线程数。

适用于OpenMP作业
parameters.name: thread

parameters.help_en: The maximum memory usage of each compute node. Units: GB, MB, and KB. The unit is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 单个计算节点最大使用内存数，支持GB、MB、KB，单位不区分大小写
parameters.name: mem

parameters.help_en:
The number of GPUs used by each compute node.

This parameter takes effect only for clusters that use the PBS scheduler and whose compute nodes contain GPUs
parameters.help_zh:
单个计算节点使用GPU的数量。

仅支持使用PBS调度器的集群，且集群内计算节点含GPU时该参数生效。
parameters.name: gpu

parameters.help_en:
The maximum running time of the job. Three formats are supported:

hh:mm:ss
mm:ss
ss

The first format is recommended. For example, if the maximum running time is 12 hours, set this parameter to 12:00:00
parameters.help_zh:
作业最大运行时间，支持三种格式：

hh:mm:ss
mm:ss
ss

推荐使用第一种格式。若最大运行时间为12小时，示例：12:00:00
parameters.name: clock_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of job retries. Valid values: 1 to 10. The job retry feature is applicable only to PBS clusters.

If this parameter is left empty, the JobRetry.Priority and JobRetry.OnExitCode parameters do not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
任务重试次数，取值范围1~10。当前任务重试功能仅适用于PBS集群。

若该参数为空，则参数JobRetry.Priority、JobRetry.OnExitCode不生效
parameters.name: job_retry_count

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the retry job. Valid values: 0 to 9. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

If this parameter is left empty, the retry job priority is calculated as min{original job priority + 1, 9}
parameters.help_zh:
重试作业优先级，取值范围：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高。

若该参数为空，则重试作业优先级=min{原作业优先级+1, 9}
parameters.name: job_retry_priority

parameters.help_en:
The condition for job retry. A job retry is triggered when the exit code matches the value of this parameter.

If this parameter is left empty, a job retry is triggered when the exit code is not 0
parameters.help_zh:
作业重试条件。退出码为参数值时，触发作业重试。

若该参数为空，退出码非0时触发作业重试
parameters.name: job_retry_on_exit_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use an asynchronous message link to submit the job.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
采用异步消息链路提交作业。

默认值：false
parameters.name: async
